pageTitle: How to stop Telkom data disappearing fast
metaDescription: Stop Telkom data disappearing by checking app usage, hotspot, bundle expiry, and fallback settings so your balance lasts longer between top-ups today.
h1: How to stop data disappearing Telkom
quickAnswer: First check your Telkom data balance with *188# or MyTelkom, then compare the same period with your phone's app usage. Check the bundle name, expiry and whether it is Telkom-only, all-network or time-restricted. Pause mobile data if the drop is unexplained, then limit the app or hotspot using it. Airtime charged after a bundle ends is a separate billing issue.

causes.cause: Apps, streaming or downloads used the bundle
causes.explanation: Background syncing, automatic media downloads and video can use mobile data. Identify the app in your phone's usage report before changing settings.

causes.cause: The balance is for a restricted bundle
causes.explanation: A Telkom-only allowance cannot be used on a roaming partner network. Check the allowance category instead of treating every remaining megabyte as all-network data.
Check the validity shown for your exact purchase. A time-restricted or expired allowance is different from data consumed by an app; do not assume every bundle lasts a month.

causes.cause: A hotspot shared your mobile data
causes.explanation: Check whether another connected device was streaming, downloading or updating during the same period.

causes.cause: Airtime or extra spend was used after data ran out
causes.explanation: Out-of-bundle billing can affect airtime or account charges. It does not explain why an unused data allowance fell, so record data and airtime balances separately.

telkom: If the balance is falling unexpectedly, pause mobile data and hotspot sharing while you investigate. Internet access will then need Wi-Fi until you turn mobile data back on.
Dial *188# from the Telkom SIM or check MyTelkom. On a dual-SIM phone, select the Telkom line. Save the balance, time, bundle name and expiry shown before buying another bundle.

Check which allowance you can use now. Telkom-only data needs Telkom coverage; all-network data can also work on roaming partner networks. Check the terms for night, social or other restricted bundles separately.

Compare the same dates in your phone's app data report. On Pixel, use Settings > Network & internet > SIMs > App data usage. Other Android menus vary. On iPhone, open Settings > Cellular or Mobile Data and check per-app usage; record the current-period counter before resetting it.

Limit the app that actually used the data. On supported Android phones, turn on Data Saver; active or unrestricted apps can still use mobile data. On iPhone, turn off mobile data for an app you want to use only on Wi-Fi. Keep large downloads and backups on Wi-Fi, and turn off an unused hotspot.

Check airtime or account charges separately if the data bundle has ended. Review the options available to your line in MyTelkom or ask Telkom support about out-of-bundle controls. Prepaid and contract lines can have different controls; use the options shown for your service.

Record another balance and usage reading after the setting change. If you still cannot account for the loss, give Telkom the timestamps, allowance category, expiry, phone usage and any charge record, and keep the support reference.

preventionTips: Check the bundle category and expiry before a top-up; use the applicable allowance rather than a combined total.
Use a phone data warning where available and compare it with the Telkom balance; handset and operator measurements may differ.
Keep large updates, backups and media downloads on Wi-Fi, and check Data Saver exceptions for apps that still need background access.
Turn off hotspot sharing when you finish and save a before-and-after record when investigating a repeated drop.

faqs.question: How do I check my Telkom data balance?
faqs.answer: Dial *188# from your Telkom SIM or use MyTelkom. On a dual-SIM phone, select the Telkom line. Note which allowance is shown and its expiry before comparing it with phone usage.

faqs.question: Why can I have Telkom data left but no connection?
faqs.answer: Telkom-only data is usable in Telkom coverage and does not work on roaming partner networks. Check whether your remaining allowance is Telkom-only, all-network or restricted to a particular time or service. A remaining balance does not establish that the allowance can be used for your current connection.

faqs.question: Why does my Telkom data drop overnight?
faqs.answer: Compare the overnight balance change with downloads, app updates, backups and hotspot activity. Also check expiry and the allowance category. An overnight drop alone does not prove background use or a billing fault.

faqs.question: Why does my phone show different usage from Telkom?
faqs.answer: Your phone measures its own data traffic, and its reporting period may differ from the bundle period. Compare the same dates and the correct SIM. Treat the handset report as a way to find likely app usage; ask Telkom to explain a disputed account balance.

faqs.question: Does stopping out-of-bundle data prevent the bundle from running out?
faqs.answer: Out-of-bundle controls concern spending after the included allowance ends. They do not stop an app consuming the bundle while data is available. Check app usage for data loss, and airtime or account records for extra charges.

Telkom app-usage and billing guidance checked separately; contract spend-limit advice is not presented as a universal prepaid control.

uniqueValueSummary: Start with three separate records: the Telkom allowance available for this connection, the phone's app usage for the same dates, and any airtime or account charges. This workflow helps distinguish consumption from expiry, coverage restrictions and billing after the bundle ends. Record the before-and-after readings so a setting change can be checked or an unexplained deduction can be raised with Telkom.
officialSupportContext: Telkom publishes *188# and MyTelkom as balance-check routes. Its usage guidance distinguishes Telkom-only from all-network data. MyTelkom billing options depend on your service; a contract spend limit is different from a prepaid setting. If balances remain unexplained, use official Telkom support with the evidence below. DataCost cannot inspect your private account or reverse a charge.
evidenceToCollect: Two timestamped Telkom balance readings for the same SIM, showing data allowance categories and airtime separately.
The purchase confirmation, bundle name, expiry and any network, time or app restriction shown for that purchase.
Phone app usage for the matching dates, including hotspot activity; save the report before resetting a usage counter.
The setting you changed, the next balance reading and any MyTelkom usage record or support reference.
whenThisDoesNotApply: This workflow focuses on mobile data used by a phone. Fixed LTE/router plans, international roaming and contract billing can have different rules. It does not establish that Telkom made an error, that a particular bundle is available to your SIM, or that phone and operator counters must match exactly. The linked public guidance was checked; private account menus and individual handset flows were not tested.
